author: The Infographics Show
description:
What if Iran already had operatives hidden across the world, just waiting for a signal?
A mysterious encrypted radio signal has intelligence agencies on edge, and some analysts believe it may be linked to covert Iranian operatives abroad.
As tensions in the Middle East escalate, concerns are growing about Iran’s global network of proxies, covert agents, and potential sleeper cells.

This investigation looks at the shadow war unfolding beyond the battlefield. From Hezbollah and the Houthis to alleged assassination plots, influence campaigns, and partnerships with criminal networks, Iran has long relied on asymmetric strategies to strike its rivals while maintaining plausible deniability.

But how real is the threat of Iran’s secret army operating outside the region, and could these hidden networks become active if the conflict escalates further?

CHAPTERS:
0:00 - Iran’s Secret Signal
0:58 - Iran Running Out of Options
1:48 - The Axis of Resistance
3:43 - Iran’s Sleeper Cells in the Wes
title: They Are Already Here. Iran's Secret Army
